Circuit Gilles Villeneuve — Montreal

Canada · montreal · theme green (island_park_day) · day circuit · read-only survey on branch cursor/montreal-survey-a1, tree base d01e19d (merges: shared-shot-tooling-5b45 and day-wet-lighting-b7b8 / PR #1979, both clean). Surveyed 2026-10-15 on SwiftShader TLX (no real GPU); 75 frames embedded.

Verdict in five lines

  1. Layout is sound. Built length is within 0.3 % of the real 4.361 km, no surface folds, min node radius 7.7 m, and verify-track and every audit check pass inside baseline.
  2. Night is the weakest cell. No floodlights or lamps are registered (lamp:"none"), so night shows only headlight pools and the pit building under a pure-black sky.
  3. The "tight pale concrete walls" of the brief are not visible in any frame; dark hedge ribbons dominate the verge instead (cause unconfirmed — see defect 2).
  4. Hard edges read as artefacts: a terrain slab edge at ~70 m, rectangular lawn patches, and a Biosphère that reads as a faceted balloon.
  5. Weather works (rain, storm, fog, overcast all respond; PR #1979 daytime fix visible), but day rain and storm stay dark and green-tinted, and wet reflections smear.

Code & scenery deep-dive

Frame frames (what each lap position shows)

  • 01 @0.00: pit building + 16 garages left, double gantry, flag masts; closed pit-end shells are present (:196–212). Grandstand teal at right. Lit well at night — the only lit area.
  • 02 @0.17: the colourful crumpled structure with a brown roof is scaffoldStand(0.1575,0.1725,1,17,…) (:303–308); trees sit through it in orbit views (broadleaf/forestEdge at 0.142–0.178 R share its gap 17–24).
  • 03 @0.33: beige stepped mass = Casino (:621) with the Biosphère sphere behind; the yellow slab at the edge is unidentified (probably a billboard/hoarding). Right of road, large pale rectangle at the edge = lawn/terrain plateau.
  • 05 @0.67: large dark-teal block is the finish rowing tower (rowingTower("montreal-rowing-tower-finish",0.625,1,48,19), :991), with a tree growing out of it — the clip-audit 1.8 m spot (hedge :143 / forestEdge :993–996).
  • 06 @0.83: a tilted blue-grey cube at the far left is building(K(0.80),1,28,18,12,16,{kind:"slab"}) (:1050–1054); in orbit it appears detached, sitting at the water edge (uncertain: may be correct perspective).

Mechanisms behind the observed defects

  • Dark segmented blocks along the road = hedge() (:141–145, nature.js:1415–1420): addBox of 1.4–1.6 m high at 9 m gap with a random "lump" box on top, coloured HEDGE. They stand where the brief expects pale walls.
  • Hard-edged lighter/darker rectangles on grass = groundPatch(... GRASS ...) lawns (:119–138): flat 0.35 m boxes, 40–48 m wide, drawn in a green close to the terrain colour, so their straight edges show in trackside views.
  • Slab edge near the horizon = terrainOuter:70 (def :47) with flatTerrain: the terrain ribbon ends 70 m from the road; beyond it only the water/bank props continue.
  • Night darkness = def lamp:"none" (:55) + night:false (:20) + dressingExclusions for lighting at 0.05–0.09 and 0.55–0.59 (:33–34); the preset table has night entries, but with numLights 0 they only change ambient, not lamps.
  • Biosphère faceted balloon = 9 stacked addFrustum rings (R 38, H 62) with 0.16–0.28 m struts (:682–729) viewed at 320 m: struts are sub-pixel and the sphere shows ring facets; at night its METAL material glows white.
  • Wet smear = renderer wet-road reflection of instanced foliage and boxes (TLX); same smear appears on other circuits per the shared lighting; not circuit data.

Cross-check against the brief and real world

  • Brief (docs/tracks/montreal.md) §4 lists "continuous concrete walls" at both edges — code lays them (:127–131), the frames show none. §5 flags the Wall of Champions at 0.955–0.99 R: code present (:1072); not visible in the six lap positions captured (0.83 and 0.00 only bracket it).
  • Hairpin: brief §4 puts L'Épingle at 0.52–0.58 (stands built at 0.54–0.56 R 24 m), while the def's T12 marker and the measured curvature peak sit at 0.598–0.618. The stands may be ≈0.05–0.07 of a lap (≈220–300 m) before the real apex in racing frame — not confirmed (frame fractions and turn fractions use different frames); needs a hairpin-apex orbit shot (frac 0.55 vs 0.60) to confirm.
  • Real-world checks (sources: Biosphère 76 m / 62 m; GS 15/21/24/34, GS 16): sizes in code match; positions are sight-lines, estimates.
  • Skyline at 1.5 km and Jacques Cartier-style bridge at 1.4 km are decorative; the real Habitat 67 is across the river on Cité du Havre, placed at 790 m (estimate).
